title: Five-bar · c1 nominal · landings and effort per controller (full-rate, sim)
source: bam_ws reports/media/five-bar-pnp-tracking-2026-10-12/report.html, comparison c1__nominal-five_bar, its statistics table "Landings and effort (full-rate evidence)" as written, read 2026-10-26. Landing = a grasp or release stop. Landing error = distance to the waypoint when the reference leaves it. Held offset = what the arm holds over the dwell's last quarter; transient overshoot = the swing beyond it. Pass-through lag = distance as the reference passes any other stop. lost = the tool left its reference by more than 100 mm: its millimetres are not a tracking error.

situation.note: The situation id path2d.json and situations.json use.

status.note: ok | lost (the tool left its reference by > 100 mm: the report writes lost, these are null).

worst_landing_mm.note: Distance to the waypoint when the reference leaves a grasp or release stop, worst landing.

held_offset_mm.note: What the arm holds over the dwell's last quarter.

overshoot_mm.note: The swing beyond the held offset.

settle_s.note: Time to settle within 1 mm; null with settle_note when the report says inf (never).

pass_lag_mm.note: Distance as the reference passes any other stop.

tcp_rms_moving_mm.note: RMS tool (TCP) error while the reference moves, full 2 ms rate.

pd_share_pct.note: Share of the command from the PD loop (the rest is the model's feed-forward).

peak_torque_nm.note: Peak torque on the large servos.

rms_torque_nm.note: RMS torque on the large servos.

settle_note.note: Why settle_s is empty when the controller ran.
